agentUrlHelp: Required for Agent-to-Agent evaluation mode. This will be used to probe the agent during evaluation.
evaluatorEndpointHelp: Required in on-prem / air-gapped deployments. The judge model must run on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you control — no requests leave your network. For methodology reasons, the judge should be a different model (and ideally a different endpoint) than the agent under test.
evaluatorUrlRequired: Required on-prem — set your internal OpenAI-compatible /v1 base URL.
evaluatorUrlHelp: OpenAI-compatible /v1 base URL (e.g. LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM).
evaluatorApiKeyPlaceholder: leave blank for keyless local servers
evaluatorModelRequired: Required on-prem — enter the model id loaded on your evaluator endpoint.
evaluatorModelNotInList: Model is not in discovered options. Manual entry is allowed; Test Evaluator Connection will validate it.
evaluatorModelHelp: Used when a report does not specify its own judge model.
manualEntryHint: Manual model entry is allowed. Use Refresh models to discover IDs from /v1/models.
noReports: No reports have been attached to this agent yet.

create.finmaBody: Under Swiss FINMA regulations, every AI agent deployed in regulated environments must have a designated human responsible for its oversight. Creating an agent here registers it in the <brand>aodit</brand> platform and allows you to attach it to reports for evaluation.
create.finmaTip: Each report must have an agent assigned before it can be run. The agent's owner, intent, and description are recorded for audit traceability.
